title: CWP/11550/2025 of CHANDER DEV Vs PUNJAB STATE POWER CORPORATION LTD AND OTHERS
respondents: Punjab State Power Corporation Ltd And Others
judge: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE DEEPINDER SINGH NALWA
text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF PUNJAB AND HARYANA AT CHANDIGARH 130 CWP-11550-2025 Date of Decision : April 28, 2025 CHANDER DEV .....Petitioner VERSUS PUNJAB STATE POWER CORPORATION LTD AND OTHERS .....Respondents CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE DEEPINDER SINGH NALWA Present : Mr. P.K.Goklaney, Advocate for the petitioner. DEEPINDER SINGH NALWA, J. (Oral)

1. In the present writ petition, the petitioner is praying for issuance of directions to the respondents to refund the amount of Rs.3,47,784/- alongwith interest from the date when it was recovered.

2. Learned counsel appearing for the petitioner, on instructions from the petitioner, submits that at this stage, he will be satisfied if a direction is given to respondent No.2 to decide his legal notice Annexure P-5, in a time bound manner.

3. Mr. Gurinder Singh, Advocate appearing for the respondents does not oppose the prayer, as made by the learned counsel for the petitioner.

4. In view of the above and without commenting upon the merits of the case, the present writ petition is hereby disposed of with a direction to respondent No.2 to decide the legal notice Annexure P-5 within a period of 06 weeks from the date of receipt of certified copy of this order. (DEEPINDER SINGH NALWA) April 28, 2025 JUDGE ajay-1 Chandigarh
